Scope & method

This is an agentless, read-only Level 1 assessment run from outside the hosts. It observes which services are reachable, whether they require authentication, and their transport posture. It does not install software, does not require credentials, and cannot assess cross-tenant fabric isolation or hardware attestation — those need deeper tiers.

Read-only assessment. Detection by observation, not exploitation. No customer payload — no model weights, prompts, training data, inference content, or object contents — was read, stored, or transmitted. Grade thresholds are provisional and will be revised as they are validated.
